ui.installHelp.title: Add to your Home Screen
ui.installHelp.intro: This browser doesn’t offer one-tap install, but you can add the app yourself:
ui.installHelp.ios.1: Tap the Share button in Safari’s toolbar.
ui.installHelp.ios.2: Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
ui.installHelp.ios.3: Tap “Add”. The app then opens full-screen from your Home Screen.
ui.installHelp.iosOther.1: Tap the Share button in the address bar.
ui.installHelp.iosOther.3: Don’t see it? Open this page in Safari and add it from there.
ui.installHelp.android.2: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
ui.installHelp.mac.1: In Safari, choose File › Add to Dock.
ui.installHelp.desktop.1: Use the install icon in the address bar or your browser’s menu. Firefox doesn’t support installing web apps.
ui.installHelp.offline: Once added, it opens like an app and keeps the trip available offline.
ui.err.data: Trip data is not cached yet. Open this page online once, then reload offline.

ui.safety.title: Useful before you set out.
ui.field.1.title: Confirm cover and road rules.
ui.field.1.body: Get written confirmation of tire, glass, underbody, gravel and roadside cover, rental road restrictions, and the vehicle’s tire policy before pickup.
ui.field.2.title: Save the route before departure.
ui.field.2.body: Download offline map areas, save the day’s route and lodging pin, and keep a charging cable available. Check live road status before mountain drives.
